title: Poetry Assessment EEG Dataset 1
description: This dataset contains 64-channel EEG recordings and behavioural ratings from participants who read and evaluated 210 short English-language texts: 70 Haiku, 70 Senryu, and 70 non-poetic control texts. Each text was rated on aesthetic appeal, vivid imagery, being moved, originality, and creativity. This first of two BIDS datasets includes 47 participants whose recordings passed technical validation. Psychometric questionnaire data and resting-state EEG are also provided.
methods_description: 64-channel EEG (BioSemi layout) was recorded while participants read poems and control texts across seven blocks and rated each on a 7-point scale for five subjective dimensions. Resting-state EEG was recorded at the beginning and end of each session. Trait questionnaires (PANAS, Openness, Curiosity, VVIQ, AVIQ, MAAS, AReA) were also collected. Data were collected at the Department of Psychology, Goldsmiths, University of London.
